name: @libre/android-app
description: Native Android wrapper (Capacitor) that hosts the @libre/wallet-pwa build and keeps the LDK node alive in the background via a foreground service. Requires the Android SDK to build — see README.md.

scripts.build: node -e "console.log('[android-app] The native APK builds on a machine with the Android SDK. See packages/android-app/README.md: pnpm cap:add (once), then build wallet-pwa, then pnpm cap:sync, then open in Android Studio.')"
